$comment: Shared entitlement-file verification fixture. commercial-model.md requires that offline and private deployments gate paid features from a signed file, and that authentication never calls a vendor licensing service on a login path. These cases pin the verification contract every SDK must implement identically in W2 Entitlement. Bytes are placeholders; the W2 implementation replaces them with real signed fixtures and a pinned vendor public key.

cases.why: The ordinary offline path: no network call at all.
A flipped byte in the payload must not verify. This is the case a naive 'decode the JSON and trust it' reader would pass.
A correctly shaped signature made by a key that is not the pinned vendor key must not verify.
An operator may pin their own public key for OEM and private-CA deployments; a file signed by that key is accepted.
A correctly signed file whose entitlement window has closed is inactive, not an error, and never silently upgraded to free-tier behaviour.
Undecodable input is an error, not an empty entitlement.
algorithm=none and any algorithm outside the Ed25519 allowlist are rejected before signature verification.

invariants: Verification is entirely local: no network call, no vendor round trip, on any path including login.
A verification failure is never downgraded to an active or free-tier entitlement.
The vendor public key is not a secret and may ship compiled in; the signing private key never enters any SDK, repository, or CI.
The private signing key is never transmitted to the SDK; only the signature and payload are.
